instruction: Preserve the verified news story and asset from editorial preflight. Use experiment A (BREAKING NEWS + MARKET IMPACT) only to vary presentation. Hook direction: the event changed the setup. End with exactly one specific question: Bullish, bearish, or wait?. Lead with the actual verified event and source; explain why it matters; connect only to the selected/news-supported asset(s). Never substitute a generic mover.
news_title: Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub

rules: Never invent chart patterns or levels.
visual_decision.reason: Use a real market chart when it adds evidence; never use decorative graphics

source: frozen opportunity + Creator Brain + Content Director + engagement strategy + fresh news
guardrail: Creator 6.0 covers the full crypto market. News is one opportunity lane, not an automatic article trigger. Frozen primary asset is authoritative. If a verified news headline explicitly names another supported asset, it is treated as an explicit multi-asset story: headline, body, cashtags and TradingView visuals must remain coherent. No arbitrary fallback asset is added.
